# Assets · Social

2 files under `assets/Social/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for social-avatar-1080.png>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Social images.

- `social-avatar-1080.png`: full mark with outlines in `sakura-red` on `cream`, centred for circular crops. For TikTok and Instagram.
- `og-image-1200x630.png`: lockup with "COMING SOON" on `cream`, for link previews. Reuse the layout, changing only the line of text, when the store launches.
